name: Forge Domain
summary: Clerics of smith gods who craft and protect.

features.name: Domain Spells
features.short: Extra spells that are always prepared.
features.summary: You always have your domain spells prepared once you reach the listed cleric levels. They don't count against the number of spells you prepare each day.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.summary: You gain proficiency with heavy armor and smith's tools.

features.name: Blessing of the Forge
features.short: After a long rest, make armor or a weapon +1.
features.summary: At the end of a long rest, touch one nonmagical suit of armor or simple/martial weapon: until your next long rest it becomes magical, with +1 to AC or to attack and damage rolls.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Artisan's Blessing
features.short: Craft a metal item worth up to 100 gp.
features.summary: You conduct an hour-long ritual that crafts a nonmagical item containing metal, worth no more than 100 gp, using metal of equal value.

features.name: Soul of the Forge
features.short: Resist fire; +1 AC in heavy armor.
features.summary: You gain resistance to fire damage. While wearing heavy armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.short: Once per turn, weapon hits deal +1d8 fire (2d8 at 14th).
features.summary: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can deal an extra 1d8 fire damage. At 14th level the extra damage becomes 2d8.

features.name: Saint of Forge and Fire
features.short: Immune to fire; resist nonmagical weapons in heavy armor.
features.summary: You gain immunity to fire damage. While wearing heavy armor, you have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.

grants.text: In heavy armor: resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing.
